title: Syllabub
hookLine: Viral British syllabub crafted for mobile Cook Mode & 1-tap Story sharing.

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {eu113_mlk} and {eu113_egg} and {eu113_sug} and {eu113_flv} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Whisk Custard Silky Over Low Heat
steps.instructionTemplate: Warm {eu113_mlk} and {eu113_sug}, whisk into {eu113_egg}, and cook gently stirring until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.
steps.creatorSecret: Keep heat medium-low and stir continuously so the custard stays satin-smooth.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {eu113_sug} and {eu113_flv} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Chill 2 Hours & Add Topping
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into dessert glasses, chill 2 hours, and crown with {eu113_flv} and whipped cream. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
